how_to_use_markdown:
Get strike keyword returns the strike based on the value/condition set in it.

It is generally used in Strike FX of position builder.

![Example](./images/img-1631880507.png)

Suppose LTP of NIFTY 50 is 17330, then the above get strike function will return 17350 as it is the nearest strike.

parameters.name: Price
parameters.description: Nested LTP(...) keyword supplying the reference price; the nearest valid exchange strike to this price is returned. Prefer Native ATM ('ATM'/'ATM SPOT' keywords) over this for index options where possible — Fx formula evaluation can fail under feed latency (Rule 37, BUG-015).
